in_sanskrit.name: Sharvilash
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है God's Warrior
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Sharvilash एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The name Sharvilash is a combination of two words - 'Sharva' and 'Ish', where 'Sharva' means God and 'Ish' means Lord. The name Sharvilash signifies the power and strength of the God. It is a name given to a child who is believed to be a warrior of God.
